extraction_notes: Catalytic data are reported graphically in Figure 9a,b for 240–300 °C at 2.0 MPa, VH2:VCO2 = 3:1 and space velocity = 3.6 L h−1 g−1; most conversion and methanol-yield values were read approximately from the plotted points. Exact methanol yields printed in the text were used for In2O3, In1.67Cr0.33O3, and In1.25Cr0.75O3 at 300 °C. Selectivities were discussed qualitatively but not reported numerically. Figure 9c stability data were not extracted as individual time-on-stream records because the time-series points are dense and no exact numerical values are printed; the text states no deactivation for In1.25Cr0.75O3 over 50 h and that In2O3 conversion remained about 7.5% after 40 h.
